newsitem.title: USA: Nutrition for Life to repurchase shares.
newsitem.headline: Nutrition for Life to repurchase shares.

text.p: Nutrition for Life International Inc said Monday its board had authorized the repurchase of up to 200,000 shares.
The buys may be conducted in the open market or through privately negotiated transactions and may be made from time to time until the buyback program expires on June 30, 1997, it said.
Nutrition for Life has 5.6 million shares outstanding.
President and Chief Executive David Bertrand said the buyback program allowed the company to repurchase some of its stock at "attractive prices."
Nutrition for Life develops, markets and sells nutritional supplements and other consumer products.
